ValidationRule.description: Pipeline: refuses an open deal (not on hold) whose quarter and year are before the current quarter. Fires only when the deal is new or its quarter, year, stage, on-hold flag or annual value changes. A blank quarter or year is allowed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(IsClosed__c), NOT(OnHold__c), NOT($Permission.Pipeline_Bypass_Quarter_Rule), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Expected_Closure_Quarter__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Expected_Closing_Year__c))), OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Expected_Closure_Quarter__c), ISCHANGED(Expected_Closing_Year__c), ISCHANGED(Stage__c), ISCHANGED(OnHold__c), ISCHANGED(AmountPerYear__c) ), VALUE(TEXT(Expected_Closing_Year__c)) * 4 + CASE(TEXT(Expected_Closure_Quarter__c), "Q1", 1, "Q2", 2, "Q3", 3, "Q4", 4, 0) < YEAR(TODAY()) * 4 + CEILING(MONTH(TODAY()) / 3) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You need to adjust the Expected Conversion Quarter and Expected Closing Year to represent when this deal is likely to close. They cannot be before the current quarter.
